description: Header file defining geohash helper functions, types, and constants for geospatial calculations.

classes.name: GeoHashRadius
classes.description: Structure representing geohash area and neighbors.

methods.name: geohashEstimateStepsByRadius
methods.description: Estimates geohash steps needed for a given radius.

methods.name: geohashBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates bounding box for a geohash radius.

methods.name: geohashGetAreasByRadius
methods.description: Retrieves geohash areas within a radius (WGS84).

methods.name: geohashGetAreasByRadiusWGS84
methods.description: Retrieves geohash areas within a radius using WGS84 coordinates.

methods.name: geohashGetAreasByRadiusMercator
methods.description: Retrieves geohash areas within a radius using Mercator projection.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRadiusWGS84
